author: packs
description: D21-T13: the per-person calling metrics count each call for the person who made it (call_attempt.owner_ref); the member's claimed_by is cleared when the outcome is saved, so it named no one.
name: sales-calling-metrics-caller

definition.name: Calling: Calls per Person per Day
definition.sql: SELECT a.owner_ref AS user_ref, date_trunc('day', a.created_at)::date AS day, COUNT(*)::bigint AS calls FROM call_attempt a JOIN call_list_member m ON m.id = a.member_ref WHERE a.is_active IS NOT FALSE AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY a.owner_ref, 2 ORDER BY 2 DESC, calls DESC

target.query: Calling: Calls per Person per Day

definition.name: Calling: Connect Rate per Person per Week
definition.sql: SELECT a.owner_ref AS user_ref, date_trunc('week', a.created_at)::date AS week, COUNT(*)::bigint AS calls, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE a.outcome = 'connected') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS connect_rate_pct FROM call_attempt a JOIN call_list_member m ON m.id = a.member_ref WHERE a.is_active IS NOT FALSE AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY a.owner_ref, 2 ORDER BY 2 DESC

target.query: Calling: Connect Rate per Person per Week

definition.name: Calling: Talk Time per Person per Day
definition.sql: SELECT a.owner_ref AS user_ref, date_trunc('day', a.created_at)::date AS day, COALESCE(SUM(a.duration_seconds), 0)::numeric AS talk_seconds FROM call_attempt a JOIN call_list_member m ON m.id = a.member_ref WHERE a.is_active IS NOT FALSE AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY a.owner_ref, 2 ORDER BY 2 DESC

target.query: Calling: Talk Time per Person per Day

definition.name: Calling: Meetings Booked per Person per Week
definition.sql: SELECT a.owner_ref AS user_ref, date_trunc('week', a.created_at)::date AS week, COUNT(DISTINCT act.id)::bigint AS meetings FROM call_attempt a JOIN call_list_member m ON m.id = a.member_ref JOIN activity act ON act.record_id::text = m.record_id AND act.activity_type = 'meeting' AND act.created_at >= a.created_at AND act.created_at < a.created_at + INTERVAL '1 day' WHERE a.is_active IS NOT FALSE AND a.created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '90 days' GROUP BY a.owner_ref, 2 ORDER BY 2 DESC

target.query: Calling: Meetings Booked per Person per Week

title: Pack: calling metrics by caller
